## Checklist

- [ ] `./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest` passes locally
- [ ] `./gradlew :app:lintDebug` passes (any new warnings are explained above)
- [ ] Commit messages are in English, imperative mood, with a Conventional-Commits-style prefix
      (`feat`, `fix`, `docs`, `build`, `refactor`, `test`, `chore`), and no automated co-author trailers
- [ ] My commits use my GitHub **no-reply** email, and the author and committer are the same identity
- [ ] The diff, commit messages, and any screenshots contain **no** private data or local file paths
- [ ] Documentation and tests are updated where relevant
